_comment: Target states for the Peregrine solver. One value table is produced per
target. Each state is the same 6-vector used everywhere in Peregrine:
ALL of it in the FIELD frame: x/y in cm, heading in rad, vx/vy in cm/s,
omega in rad/s. A target with zero velocity means 'arrive and stop',
while a nonzero velocity means 'pass through this point already moving
that way' -- useful for chaining motions without stopping.
